description: This file contains functions that generate PowerPoint presentations programmatically, utilizing the pptxgenjs library. It includes utilities for data URL conversions, applying transformations, assembling slides with text and images based on templates and user data, and exporting the presentation as a Blob object with a filename.

methods.name: isProbablyDataUrl(v)
methods.description: Checks if a given string is likely a Data URL by verifying if it starts with 'data:'.

methods.name: fileToDataUrl(file)
methods.description: Converts a File object or a string URL to a Data URL, or returns the string if it already appears to be a Data URL.

methods.name: urlToDataUrl(url)
methods.description: Fetches a URL and converts the response blob into a Data URL.

methods.name: applyTransform(value, transformName)
methods.description: Applies specified transformations like bulletsToLines, formatPercent, or formatCurrency to a value.

methods.name: resolveDeckTitle(wizardData)
methods.description: Determines the title for the deck based on provided wizardData, prioritizing globalFirst.name or defaulting to 'presentation'.

methods.name: safeFileName(name)
methods.description: Sanitizes and trims a string to produce a safe filename with only lowercase alphanumerics, hyphens, underscores, and spaces.

methods.name: resolveValueForStep(wizardData, slideStep, fieldId)
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate value for a given slide step and field from the wizardData, considering scope and group.

methods.name: ptToIn(pt)
methods.description: Converts points to inches (points per inch = 72).

methods.name: addFallbackText(slide, i, placeholderId, value)
methods.description: Adds placeholder fallback text to a slide for missing or null values.

methods.name: addFallbackImage(slide, i, placeholderId, fileOrUrl)
methods.description: Adds an image placeholder or fallback text to a slide if an image URL or file cannot be loaded.

methods.name: renderFixedShapes(slide, layout, templateIndex)
methods.description: Renders fixed shapes (rectangles, pictures) on a slide based on the layout's fixedShapes array.

methods.name: generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData })
methods.description: Main exported function that constructs a PPTX presentation based on input data, templates, and slide order, then returns the Blob and filename.

ctags.name: generatePptx
ctags.pattern: /^export async function generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData/
